v.en: O God, come to my assistance;

r.en: O Lord, make haste to help me.

source.scope: Psalmi & antiphonæ ex Psalterio secundum diem

text.la: Exaltáte * Dóminum Deum nostrum, et adoráte in monte sancto eius.
text.en: Exalt ye the Lord * our God, and worship him upon his holy mountain.

text.la: Éripe me * de inimícis meis, Dómine, ad te confúgi.
text.en: Deliver me from my enemies, * O Lord, to thee have I fled.

text.la: Benedixísti, * Dómine, terram tuam: remisísti iniquitátem plebis tuæ.
text.en: Lord, thou hast blessed thy land; * Thou hast forgiven the iniquity of thy people.

text.la: In Dómino iustificábitur * et laudábitur omne semen Israël.
text.en: In the Lord * shall all the seed of Israel be justified and praised.

text.la: Surge, illumináre Ierúsalem, quia venit lumen tuum, et glória Dómini super te orta est.
text.en: Arise, be enlightened, O Jerusalem: for thy light is come, and the glory of the Lord is risen upon thee.

text.la: Tria sunt múnera, * quæ obtulérunt Magi Dómino, aurum, thus et myrrham, Fílio Dei, Regi magno, allelúia.
text.en: Gold, frankincense, and myrrh, * are the three precious gifts which the wise men offered unto the Lord, as unto the Son of God, the Great King. Alleluia.

text.la: Deus, qui hodiérna die Unigénitum tuum géntibus stella duce revelásti: concéde propítius; ut qui iam te ex fide cognóvimus, usque ad contemplándam spéciem tuæ celsitúdinis perducámur.
text.en: O God, Who by the leading of a star didst, as on this day, manifest thine Only-begotten Son to the Gentiles, mercifully grant that we, which know thee now by faith, may after this life have the fruition of thy glorious Godhead:
